name: @dgtalbug/iris
description: Visual, versioned HTML docs for AI coding work.

scripts.release:check: pnpm lint && pnpm format && pnpm token-lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm html-check && pnpm smoke:install

runtimeDependencyRationale.ajv: JSON Schema validation for strict contract enforcement
runtimeDependencyRationale.lucide: Icon geometry serialised to inline SVG at generation time; never loaded by a generated page
runtimeDependencyRationale.markdown-it: Generation-time semantic Markdown rendering with embedded HTML disabled
runtimeDependencyRationale.mermaid: Pinned browser runtime copied locally by iris vendor for strict offline diagram rendering
